records.translation: El trabajo se divide en dos para que ninguna llamada al sistema de archivos se ejecute en la ruta principal de ejecución GUI. Lo que permanece aquí es el estado del widget — el campo ``src``, y si nombra algo — y es gratis. Lo cual se movió en :meth:`_refresh_job` es cada llamada del sistema de ficheros: ``find_scorecards`` caminando por las carpetas de microplacas de laboratorio del usuario, una ``os.stat`` por tarjeta, y ``read_digest`` abriendo y analizando el CSVs. Todo es E/S en una ruta que el usuario proporcionó.

records.context: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.label: spacr.qt.prerun.SegQCBanner.refresh#2
records.source: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.
records.translation: Medido en una estación de trabajo: ``os.path.exists`` en una ruta bajo ``/nas_mnt`` — un montaje ``autofs`` cuya parte estaba dormida — no había regresado después de veinte segundos, porque el estado es lo que activa el automontaje. Este método utilizado para hacer ese trabajo en línea, y ``install_qc_banner`` solía llamarlo dentro de ``MainWindow._build_screen``, por lo que era toda la interfaz congelada en cada Medida abierta. No dejó traceback, porque un bucle de eventos estancado no es un accidente; se informó como "apertura de códigos de barras mapa bloquea spacr", más fliper y vislumbres de otras pantallas.

records.context: A suggestion is judged, not relabelled. An extracted image region Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the structured-data name legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. See :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` and :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.annotate#10
records.source: A suggestion is judged, not relabelled. A crop Suggest proposed a class for wears an amber ``?`` badge beside its dashed ring. A click or ``Y`` confirms it (it becomes an ordinary label and wears a green tick); a right-click or ``N`` rejects it (it goes back to unanswered and wears a red cross); ``U`` undoes either. The bar above the key legend says so, and counts what the page and the column hold. Each judgement is written to the ``<column>_verdict`` column as ``+c`` or ``-c``, so it survives a restart, and the next Suggest round is handed the rejections to train on. See :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` and :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.
records.translation: Una sugerencia es juzgada, no reetiquetada. Una región de imagen extraída Sugerir propuso una clase para llevar una insignia de ámbar ``?`` junto a su anillo rayado. Un clic o ``Y`` lo confirma (se convierte en una etiqueta ordinaria y lleva una marca de verificación verde); un clic derecho o ``N`` lo rechaza (se vuelve a sin respuesta y usa una cruz roja); ``U`` lo deshace o bien. La barra encima de la leyenda del nombre de los datos estructurados lo dice, y cuenta lo que la página y la columna sostienen. Cada juicio está escrito en la columna ``<column>_verdict`` como ``+c`` o ``-c``, por lo que sobrevive a un reinicio, y la siguiente ronda Sugerencia se entrega a los rechazos para entrenar. Ver :meth:`AnnotateScreen._judge` y :func:`spacr.suggest.verdict_column`.

records.source: `retarget_field_tooltips` is how the rest of the tool does this -- every dialog and side panel calls it at the end of its `__init__` -- and the main settings form was the one place that never did. records.label: spacr.qt.screens.convert#1
records.source: Converting renames files, for example ND2 files to ``plate1_A01_T0001F001L01A01Z01C01.tif``, and the new names no longer show which source file they came from, so a wrong well assignment can go unnoticed. This screen therefore does two things :func:`spacr.io.convert_to_yokogawa` does not: it shows the source → target table *before* writing, and it emits a map file that turns every converted name back into the original one.
records.translation: Convertir archivos de renombrados, por ejemplo archivos ND2 a ``plate1_A01_T0001F001L01A01Z01C01.tif``, y los nuevos nombres ya no muestran de qué archivo fuente vinieron, por lo que una asignación incorrecta puede pasar desapercibida. Por lo tanto, esta pantalla hace dos cosas :func:`spacr.io.convert_to_yokogawa` no lo hace: muestra la tabla de destino → de origen *antes de escribir* y emite un archivo de mapa que convierte cada nombre convertido de nuevo en el original.

records.source: The screen never deletes anything itself: it holds a :class:`spacr.data_manager.PrunePlan` and hands it back with its own token. A plan that has gone stale — because a run wrote into the project while the screen was open — is refused by the module, not by this file, which is where that check belongs.
records.translation: La pantalla nunca borra nada en sí misma: sostiene un :class:`spacr.data_manager.PrunePlan` y lo devuelve con su propio token. Un plan que se ha vuelto rancio —porque una sesión de procesamiento escrita en el proyecto mientras la pantalla estaba abierta— es rechazado por el módulo, no por este archivo, que es donde pertenece esa comprobación.

records.context: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#3
records.source: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.translation: **Para qué sirve.** Dar a cada objeto un vector en el que no entró ninguna etiqueta. El panel medido dice lo grande que es una célula y lo brillante que era cada tinción; una incrustación describe cómo es la célula, en unos pocos cientos de números una columna vertebral preentrenada produce sin que se le diga qué buscar. Complementa el panel en lugar de reemplazarlo: un fenotipo que ninguna captura de columna medida puede ser representada en el vector.

records.context: **What to do next.** Treat the columns as a feature source, not as a result. They are consumed exactly as the measured panel is -- a reduction to see whether the objects separate, a regression against the perturbation, a retrieval to find the objects most like one you picked. The screening experiment repeats the corresponding warning under the table: a single dimension is not a phenotype, and these numbers can only be interpreted through an analysis that uses the whole vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#6
records.source: **What to do next.** Treat the columns as a feature source, not as a result. They are consumed exactly as the measured panel is -- a reduction to see whether the objects separate, a regression against the perturbation, a retrieval to find the objects most like one you picked. The screen repeats the corresponding warning under the table: a single dimension is not a phenotype, and these numbers can only be interpreted through an analysis that uses the whole vector.
records.translation: **Qué hacer a continuación.** Tratar las columnas como una fuente de características, no como un resultado. Se consumen exactamente como el panel medido es -- una reducción para ver si los objetos se separan, una regresión contra la perturbación, una recuperación para encontrar los objetos más parecidos a uno elegido. La pantalla repite la advertencia correspondiente debajo de la tabla: una sola dimensión no es un fenotipo, y estos números sólo se pueden interpretar a través de un análisis que utiliza todo el vector.

records.context: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#8
records.source: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.translation: **La política de canal es el primer control en la pantalla.** La combinación de canales no debe decidirse implícitamente por lo que la columna vertebral espera. La codificación por canal mantiene el canal en cada nombre de columna y cuesta N hacia adelante; la proyección mezcla los canales en tres y cuesta uno. Estos producen columnas de anchura idéntica y dtype que significan cosas completamente diferentes, así que la pantalla hace explícita la elección y dice lo que cuesta cada uno.

records.context: **A single dimension is not a phenotype, and the screening experiment states this under the table.** The table shows the first few dimensions so the user can see that the embedding ran; the caption says they are not interpretable individually. Showing `emb_c2_017 = 0.43` without that caption invites reading one dimension as a phenotype.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#9
records.source: **A single dimension is not a phenotype, and the screen states this under the table.** The table shows the first few dimensions so the user can see that the embedding ran; the caption says they are not interpretable individually. Showing `emb_c2_017 = 0.43` without that caption invites reading one dimension as a phenotype.
records.translation: **Una sola dimensión no es un fenotipo, y la pantalla lo indica debajo de la tabla.** La tabla muestra las primeras dimensiones para que el usuario pueda ver que la incrustación corrió; la leyenda dice que no son interpretables individualmente. Mostrando `emb_c2_017 = 0.43` sin esa leyenda invita a leer una dimensión como fenotype.

records.source: The load runs as two jobs. Planning is a count and a select, so it comes back in milliseconds and the screen can say what was matched -- or why nothing was -- before committing to read a single pixel. Only then does the second job start, and it reports after every page.
records.translation: La carga se ejecuta como dos trabajos. La planificación es un conteo y un select, por lo que vuelve en milisegundos y la pantalla puede decir lo que fue emparejado -- o por qué nada fue -- antes de comprometerse a leer un solo píxel. Sólo entonces comienza el segundo trabajo, e informa después de cada página.

records.context: :mod:`spacr.foreign` does the work; this screen is for the step that needs review. A foreign ``Area`` can be in µm² where spaCR's ``cell_area`` is in px², so an unreviewed mapping can give values that look plausible and are wrong by a factor of several hundred. So the mapping table is the middle of the screen, it is **editable**, and every edit re-runs the conflict and unit checks in place.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#1
records.source: :mod:`spacr.foreign` does the work; this screen is for the step that needs review. A foreign ``Area`` can be in µm² where spaCR's ``cell_area`` is in px², so an unreviewed mapping can give values that look plausible and are wrong by a factor of several hundred. So the mapping table is the middle of the screen, it is **editable**, and every edit re-runs the conflict and unit checks in place.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.foreign` hace el trabajo; esta pantalla es para el paso que necesita revisión. Un ``Area`` extranjero puede estar en µm² donde el ``cell_area`` de spaCR está en px², por lo que una asignación sin revisar puede dar valores que parecen plausibles y están equivocados por un factor de varios cientos. Así que la tabla de asignación es el centro de la pantalla, es **editable**, y cada edición vuelve a ejecutar los controles de conflicto y unidad en su lugar.

records.context: **Preview writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.foreign.plan_import` scans, pairs and verifies; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a blocking problem — a target that collides with a spaCR feature name, a measurement table with no object-label column, a microscope field of view whose masks do not pair.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#4
records.source: **Preview writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.foreign.plan_import` scans, pairs and verifies; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a blocking problem — a target that collides with a spaCR feature name, a measurement table with no object-label column, a field whose masks do not pair.
records.translation: **Preview no escribe nada.** :func:`spacr.foreign.plan_import` escanea, empareja y verifica; ``Import`` es una prensa separada, y permanece inhabilitada mientras el plan tiene un problema de bloqueo — un objetivo que choca con un nombre de característica spaCR, una tabla de medición sin columna de etiqueta de objeto, un campo de visión del microscopio cuyas máscaras no se emparejan.

records.context: An edit emits :attr:`mapping_edited` *as well as* ``dataChanged``, and the screen listens to the former. Hanging the live re-resolve off ``dataChanged`` looks equivalent and is not: re-resolving updates the per-row status, updating the status refreshes the tooltips, and refreshing tooltips emits ``dataChanged`` again — one keystroke recursed until the interpreter ran out of stack.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign.ColumnMapModel#2
records.source: An edit emits :attr:`mapping_edited` *as well as* ``dataChanged``, and the screen listens to the former. Hanging the live re-resolve off ``dataChanged`` looks equivalent and is not: re-resolving updates the per-row status, updating the status refreshes the tooltips, and refreshing tooltips emits ``dataChanged`` again — one keystroke recursed until the interpreter ran out of stack.
records.translation: Una edición emite :attr:`mapping_edited` *así como* ``dataChanged``, y la pantalla escucha a la primera. Colgar el re-resuelve en vivo ``dataChanged`` parece equivalente y no es: volver a resolver actualizaciones por fila, actualizar el estado actualiza las sugerencias de las herramientas, y refrescantes consejos de herramientas emite ``dataChanged`` de nuevo — una pulsación de teclas se repite hasta que el intérprete se quedó sin pila.

records.context: **Recrop** is the ninth and is the only one that changes WHICH field is on application view rather than what is painted on it. A staged extracted image region holding several cells is not one training example, and curating it as one teaches a network that two objects are one picture -- so a box round an object writes that region of both the image and the mask as a field of its own (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), queued straight after the current field, and the multi-object original is retired into ``recropped_originals/`` rather than curated (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). A box shorter than :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` on a side, or repeating a cut already made past :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`, is refused; objects the box cuts through are dropped, because an object whose boundary is where the mouse was released is not that object; and the labels that survive are renumbered from one.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#4
records.source: **Recrop** is the ninth and is the only one that changes WHICH field is on screen rather than what is painted on it. A staged crop holding several cells is not one training example, and curating it as one teaches a network that two objects are one picture -- so a box round an object writes that region of both the image and the mask as a field of its own (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), queued straight after the current field, and the multi-object original is retired into ``recropped_originals/`` rather than curated (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). A box shorter than :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` on a side, or repeating a cut already made past :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`, is refused; objects the box cuts through are dropped, because an object whose boundary is where the mouse was released is not that object; and the labels that survive are renumbered from one.
records.translation: **Recrop** es el noveno y es el único que cambia el campo QUE está en la vista de la aplicación en lugar de lo que se pinta en ella. Una región de imagen extraída por etapas que contiene varias células no es un ejemplo de entrenamiento, y la cura como se enseña una red que dos objetos son una imagen -- por lo que una caja alrededor de un objeto escribe esa región de la imagen y la máscara como un campo propio (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.write_recrop`), en cola justo después del campo actual, y el original de multi-objeto se retira en ``recropped_originals/`` en vez de comisariado (:func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.retire_recropped_original`). Se rechaza una caja más corta que :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MIN_SIDE` en un lado, o la repetición de un corte ya hecho pasado :data:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.RECROP_MAX_OVERLAP`; los objetos que la caja corta son dejados caer, porque un objeto cuyo límite es donde el ratón fue liberado no es ese objeto; y las etiquetas que sobreviven son renumeradas de uno.

records.context: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the workflow itself calls: it maps every pre-SAM name onto ``cpsam``, keeps a fine-tuned checkpoint path as itself, and raises rather than quietly substituting stock weights for a checkpoint that is not there. records.source: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the pipeline itself calls: it maps every pre-SAM name onto ``cpsam``, keeps a fine-tuned checkpoint path as itself, and raises rather than quietly substituting stock weights for a checkpoint that is not there. Going around it with a second, simpler call would give this screen a different answer from the run it is meant to be correcting.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` es lo que el propio flujo de trabajo llama: mapea cada nombre pre-SAM en ``cpsam``, mantiene una ruta de control afinada como sí misma, y aumenta en lugar de sustituir silenciosamente los pesos de existencias por un punto de control que no está allí. Al girar alrededor de él con una segunda llamada, más simple daría a esta pantalla una respuesta diferente de la sesión de procesamiento que se supone que está corrigiendo.

records.context: Two kinds of fold are used here, and they change this screen differently. Timelapse is a settings fold: switching it on mounts its categories on Mask's own form and sets the workflow data-selection boundary the processing session reads, so its switch belongs on the masthead strip beside the heading. OPS is a page fold: it has 63 settings of its own and its own run entry point, none of which is `preprocess_generate_masks`, so switching it on puts it on this screen's page strip instead and its switch sits in the actions row beside the Live and 3D buttons, in the same format. See :data:`CATEGORY_FOLDS`, :data:`PAGE_FOLDS` and :func:`install_ops_switch`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.mask#1
records.source: Two kinds of fold are used here, and they change this screen differently. Timelapse is a settings fold: switching it on mounts its categories on Mask's own form and sets the pipeline gate the run reads, so its switch belongs on the masthead strip beside the heading. OPS is a page fold: it has 63 settings of its own and its own run entry point, none of which is `preprocess_generate_masks`, so switching it on puts it on this screen's page strip instead and its switch sits in the actions row beside the Live and 3D buttons, in the same format. See :data:`CATEGORY_FOLDS`, :data:`PAGE_FOLDS` and :func:`install_ops_switch`.
records.translation: Aquí se usan dos tipos de pliegues, y cambian esta pantalla de manera diferente. Timelapse es un pliegue de configuración: cambiarlo en monta sus categorías en el propio formulario de Mask y establecer el límite de selección de datos de flujo de trabajo que lee la sesión de procesamiento, por lo que su interruptor pertenece a la tira mástil al lado del encabezado. OPS es un doblez de página: tiene 63 ajustes propios y su propio punto de entrada de ejecución, ninguno de los cuales es `preprocess_generate_masks`, así que encaminarlo lo pone en la tira de página de esta pantalla en su lugar y su interruptor se encuentra en la fila de acciones junto a los botones Live y 3D, en el mismo formato. Ver :data:`CATEGORY_FOLDS`, :data:`PAGE_FOLDS` y :func:`install_ops_switch`.

records.context: ``threaded=False`` (which every test in ``test_plate_view.py`` and ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py`` constructs the screen with) runs the job inline through :meth:`_run_job`, so those callers still get the old meaning exactly. A caller that needs to know the grid is up waits on :meth:`active_jobs`, as ``render_plate``'s callers already do -- ``render_plate`` has returned "started, not finished" since the database read was with worker execution, and this is the same promise.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.plate_view.PlateViewScreen.recompute#3
records.source: ``threaded=False`` (which every test in ``test_plate_view.py`` and ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py`` constructs the screen with) runs the job inline through :meth:`_run_job`, so those callers still get the old meaning exactly. A caller that needs to know the grid is up waits on :meth:`active_jobs`, as ``render_plate``'s callers already do -- ``render_plate`` has returned "started, not finished" since the database read was threaded, and this is the same promise.
records.translation: ``threaded=False`` (que cada prueba en ``test_plate_view.py`` y ``test_plate_view_linked_filter.py`` construye la pantalla con) se ejecuta la línea de trabajo a través de :meth:`_run_job`, por lo que los que llaman todavía tienen el antiguo significado exactamente. Un llamante que necesita saber que la cuadrícula está arriba espera en :meth:`active_jobs`, como ya lo hacen los llamantes de ``render_plate`` -- ``render_plate`` ha devuelto "comenzado, no terminado" ya que la base de datos leída fue con la ejecución del trabajador, y esta es la misma promesa.

records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#2
records.source: It computes nothing. records.translation: No calcula nada. records.source: **Methods & Results** builds the run digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.translation: **Métodos y resultados** construye el compendio de la sesión de procesamiento -- versiones de paquetes, tiempos, política de semillas y errores, parámetros por módulo analizados de la macro emitida, el veredicto de segmentación, recuentos de artefactos, métricas ocultas -- redacta las dos secciones de ella y luego comprueba mecánicamente cada número en el borrador de nuevo contra el compendio. Se abre sembrado con el proyecto la pantalla de regresión ya está apuntada, por lo que la ruta que de otra manera pide al usuario que teclee se rellena.

records.context: A settings CSV, a restored session or a recipe belongs to one of the two modules, and applying it to both would write a training folder into the Apply tab's path field — the one thing the two-field split exists to prevent. The chosen tab is raised, so the settings are visible where they landed.
records.translation: Una configuración CSV, una sesión restaurada o una receta pertenece a uno de los dos módulos, y aplicarla a ambos escribiría una carpeta de entrenamiento en el campo de ruta de la pestaña Aplicar — la única cosa que existe la división de dos campos para evitar. La pestaña se elige por la cual uno posee más de los nombres de datos estructurados que el OTRO no tiene, por lo que ``n_epochs`` selecciona las opciones de Entrenar y ``flow_threshold`` aplica; una asignación de valor clave que distingue ni va a la pestaña ya en vista de la aplicación. records.context: So the background is synthesised with numpy at the display's native pixel size and cached to the user's config directory, keyed by ``(width, height, variant, seed, CACHE_VERSION)``. It is computed once per screen size and reloaded from disk on every later launch.
records.label: spacr.qt.space#5
records.source: So the background is synthesised with numpy at the display's native pixel size and cached to the user's config directory, keyed by ``(width, height, variant, seed, CACHE_VERSION)``. It is computed once per screen size and reloaded from disk on every later launch.
records.translation: Así que el fondo se sintetiza con numpy en el tamaño nativo del píxel de la pantalla y se almacena en caché en el directorio de configuración del usuario, con clave ``(width, height, variant, seed, CACHE_VERSION)``. Se calcula una vez por tamaño de pantalla y vuelve a cargar desde el disco en cada lanzamiento posterior.

records.context: One snapshot shows where the thread was, not where the time went; the two differ when the stall is a loop rather than a single blocking call. Measured: four stalls of the same module sweep gave four different last frames -- an event filter, a screen constructor, a settings-search install, another event filter -- which is a list of suspects rather than an answer.

records.source: One snapshot shows where the thread was, not where the time went; the two differ when the stall is a loop rather than a single blocking call. Measured: four stalls of the same module sweep gave four different last frames -- an event filter, a screen constructor, a settings-search install, another event filter -- which is a list of suspects rather than an answer.
records.translation: Una instantánea muestra dónde estaba el hilo, no dónde había pasado el tiempo; los dos difieren cuando el puesto es un bucle en lugar de una sola llamada de bloqueo. Medido: cuatro puestos del mismo módulo de barrido dieron cuatro últimos marcos diferentes -- un filtro de evento, un constructor de pantalla, una instalación de configuración-búsqueda, otro filtro de eventos -- que es una lista de sospechosos en vez de una respuesta.

records.context: A screen root is a QSS scope: rules installed there reach that screen and its descendants, and applying them before the root is shown preserves the same first-paint contract without touching Home or any previously opened module.

records.source: A screen root is a QSS scope: rules installed there reach that screen and its descendants, and applying them before the root is shown preserves the same first-paint contract without touching Home or any previously opened module.
records.translation: Una raíz de pantalla es un ámbito QSS: las reglas instaladas allí alcanzan esa pantalla y sus descendientes, y aplicarlas antes de que se muestre la raíz preserva el mismo contrato de primera pintura sin tocar Home ni ningún módulo previamente abierto.

records.context: The suffix contains every registered block absent from the application sheet, in registry order, rather than only ``names``.  This keeps blocks imported by a screen's dependencies together and means a later call can replace one complete suffix instead of stacking fragments with different preference values.  ``names`` remains the caller's documentation of the blocks it requires; omitting it is the MainWindow screen-host path.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.ensure_widget_qss_applied#4
records.source: The suffix contains every registered block absent from the application sheet, in registry order, rather than only ``names``.  This keeps blocks imported by a screen's dependencies together and means a later call can replace one complete suffix instead of stacking fragments with different preference values.  ``names`` remains the caller's documentation of the blocks it requires; omitting it is the MainWindow screen-host path.
records.translation: El sufijo contiene todos los bloques registrados ausentes de la hoja de aplicación, en orden de registro, en lugar de sólo ``names``. Esto mantiene los bloques importados por las dependencias de una pantalla juntos y significa que una llamada posterior puede reemplazar un sufixo completo en vez de apilar fragmentos con diferentes valores de preferencia. ``names`` sigue siendo la documentación del llamante de los bloques que necesita; omitiendo es la ruta MainWindow del host de pantalla.

records.context: The sheet in force is not `app.styleSheet()` any more. Per-window sheeting takes the application sheet DOWN on purpose and gives each window its own, so `app.styleSheet()` is empty in every production run -- and this function read that as "nobody opted in" and returned before doing anything. Measured: opening one module registers four blocks (`SettingsBox`, `ClassEditor`, `SettingAlphabetChip`, `TableChip`) and NONE of the four reached the screen that had just imported them. That is the exact defect this function was written for, reintroduced by the change that made the window the sheet's owner.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.ensure_widget_qss_applied#6
records.source: THE SHEET IN FORCE IS NOT `app.styleSheet()` ANY MORE. Per-window sheeting takes the application sheet DOWN on purpose and gives each window its own, so `app.styleSheet()` is empty in every production run -- and this function read that as "nobody opted in" and returned before doing anything. Measured: opening one module registers four blocks (`SettingsBox`, `ClassEditor`, `SettingAlphabetChip`, `TableChip`) and NONE of the four reached the screen that had just imported them. That is the exact defect this function was written for, reintroduced by the change that made the window the sheet's owner.
records.translation: La hoja en vigor ya no es `app.styleSheet()`. La hoja por ventana toma la hoja de aplicación DOWN a propósito y da a cada ventana su propia, por lo que `app.styleSheet()` está vacío en cada ejecución de producción -- y esta función lee que como "nobody opted in" y regresó antes de hacer nada. Medido: abrir un módulo registra cuatro bloques (`SettingsBox`, `ClassEditor`, `SettingAlphabetChip`, `TableChip`) y NINGUNA de las cuatro alcanzó la pantalla que acababa de importarlos. Ese es el defecto exacto para el que esta función fue escrita, reintroducida por el cambio que hizo que la ventana fuera el propietario de la hoja.

records.context: Called by the exhaustive/default :func:`stylesheet` path before it composes anything.  The production preference path opts out so unopened data screens do not import their scientific dependencies merely to contribute decoration.

records.source: Called by the exhaustive/default :func:`stylesheet` path before it composes anything.  The production preference path opts out so unopened data screens do not import their scientific dependencies merely to contribute decoration.
records.translation: Llamada por la ruta exhaustiva/predeterminado :func:`stylesheet` antes de componer cualquier cosa. La ruta de preferencia de producción opta por no abrir las pantallas de datos no importa sus dependencias científicas simplemente para aportar decoración.

records.context: The sweep cannot be narrowed to exact types. Doing that flips **every** view in the application at once, and the ones already sitting on a pane would then stack two translucent greys and read about 0.49 — a shade no position of the page-opacity slider can produce. Nor can a type test make the distinction: Hit List's ``QTreeWidget`` is the page and Control Chart's ``QListWidget`` is a passenger, and the pair after them is the other way round. Only the screen that built the layout knows which it is, so the screen is asked, once, per view.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.mark_surface#3
records.source: The sweep cannot be narrowed to exact types. Doing that flips **every** view in the application at once, and the ones already sitting on a pane would then stack two translucent greys and read about 0.49 — a shade no position of the page-opacity slider can produce. Nor can a type test make the distinction: Hit List's ``QTreeWidget`` is the page and Control Chart's ``QListWidget`` is a passenger, and the pair after them is the other way round. Only the screen that built the layout knows which it is, so the screen is asked, once, per view.
records.translation: El barrido no se puede reducir a tipos exactos. Hacer que la vista **cada** en la aplicación a la vez, y los que ya están sentados en un panel apilaría dos grises translúcidos y leería alrededor de 0.49 — una sombra sin posición del deslizador de opacidad de página puede producir. Tampoco puede una prueba de tipo hacer la distinción: Hit List ``QTreeWidget`` es la página y el Gráfico de Control ``QListWidget`` es un pasajero, y el par después de ellos es al revés. Sólo la pantalla que construyó el diseño sabe cuál es, por lo que la pantalla se pregunta, una vez, por vista.

records.context: Opt-**in** rather than opt-out on purpose. Today every view in the application is swept, so opting in changes nothing except where a screen says so, and a view nobody has looked at keeps the behaviour it was written against.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.mark_surface#4
records.source: Opt-**in** rather than opt-out on purpose. Today every view in the application is swept, so opting in changes nothing except where a screen says so, and a view nobody has looked at keeps the behaviour it was written against.
records.translation: Opt-**in** en lugar de opt-out a propósito. Hoy en día cada vista en la aplicación se barre, por lo que optar en cambios nada excepto cuando una pantalla lo dice, y una vista que nadie ha mirado mantiene el comportamiento en contra de que fue escrito.

records.source: The shipped ``QTabBar``/``QTabWidget::pane`` rules paint ``P["surface"]`` and ``P["surface_alt"]`` — **raw hex**, so a tab strip that is the main content of a screen (Classifier Evaluation, Run History) sat there as a flat opaque slab while the cards beside it thinned with the slider.

records.context: The single accessor every container should use, including the ones styled inline rather than through :func:`stylesheet`. Those were the gap: Home's aside panels, the dock and the tile boxes all read :func:`active_palette` directly, which returns **raw hex**, so they stayed fully opaque no matter what the preference said and the setting looked broken from the page the user lands on.

records.source: The single accessor every container should use, including the ones styled inline rather than through :func:`stylesheet`. Those were the gap: Home's aside panels, the dock and the tile boxes all read :func:`active_palette` directly, which returns **raw hex**, so they stayed fully opaque no matter what the preference said and the setting looked broken from the page the user lands on.
records.translation: El único accesorio que cada contenedor debe utilizar, incluyendo los estilos en línea en lugar de a través de :func:`stylesheet`. Esos eran los espacios: Paneles de apartamiento de la casa, el muelle y las cajas de mosaicos leídos directamente :func:`active_palette`, que devuelve **raw hex**, por lo que se mantuvieron totalmente opaco sin importar lo que la preferencia dijo y el ajuste parecía roto de la página en la que el usuario aterriza.

records.context: White in the dark themes, near-black in the light one, because that is what ``fg`` already is. Horizontal cards and interactive hover states still use it; resting Home module tiles deliberately do not. Deriving it from ``fg`` rather than writing ``#ffffff`` means every palette gets the right ink without a raw colour drifting out of sync.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.rim_colour#1
records.source: White in the dark themes, near-black in the light one, because that is what ``fg`` already is. Horizontal cards and interactive hover states still use it; resting Home module tiles deliberately do not. Deriving it from ``fg`` rather than writing ``#ffffff`` means every palette gets the right ink without a raw colour drifting out of sync.
records.translation: Blanco en los temas oscuros, casi negro en la luz, porque eso es lo que ``fg`` ya es. Las tarjetas horizontales y los estados interactivos hover todavía lo utilizan; descansando los mosaicos del módulo Inicio deliberadamente no lo hacen. Derivándolo de ``fg`` en lugar de escribir ``#ffffff`` significa que cada paleta obtiene la tinta correcta sin que un color crudo se desvíe de la sincronización.

records.context: Merging four pathogens onto their cell means picking one number per column, and which number depends on what the column measures. The rules choose correctly for most columns; because a wrong default would otherwise go unnoticed, the whole plan is shown, with every row changeable.

records.source: Merging four pathogens onto their cell means picking one number per column, and which number depends on what the column measures. The rules choose correctly for most columns; because a wrong default would otherwise go unnoticed, the whole plan is shown, with every row changeable.

Las reglas eligen correctamente para la mayoría de las columnas; debido a que un defecto incorrecto pasaría desapercibido, se muestra todo el plan, con cada fila cambiable.

records.context: Performance depends on hardware, display size, theme, and concurrent work. Density controls population independently of Detail. Detail controls sampling resolution, and buffers stay within the actual screen-pixel budget. Increasing Detail does not trim the selected population. Legacy direct engine callers may still set blur, but Preferences exposes no Blur control. Hidden widgets stop rendering entirely. Historical timings above do not establish native 24 FPS at current maximum controls.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#58
records.source: Performance depends on hardware, display size, theme, and concurrent work. Density controls population independently of Detail. Detail controls sampling resolution, and buffers stay within the actual screen-pixel budget. Increasing Detail does not trim the selected population. Legacy direct engine callers may still set blur, but Preferences exposes no Blur control. Hidden widgets stop rendering entirely. Historical timings above do not establish native 24 FPS at current maximum controls.
records.translation: El rendimiento depende del hardware, el tamaño de la pantalla, el tema y el trabajo concurrente. La densidad controla la población independientemente del detalle. El detalle detallado controla la resolución de muestreo y los búferes permanecen dentro del presupuesto real de los píxeles de pantalla. El aumento del detalle no recorta la población seleccionada. Las llamadas a motores directos legados todavía pueden desenfocar, pero las preferencias no exponen ningún control de desenrollado. Los widgets ocultos dejan de renderizarse por completo.

records.source: How many of a pool of ``pool`` elements to draw, when the theme's own count is ``base``. At least one: a density slider that can empty the screen is an off switch wearing a disguise.
records.translation: ¿Cuántos elementos ``pool`` hay que dibujar, cuando el número del tema es ``base``? Al menos uno: un deslizador de densidad que puede vaciar la pantalla es un interruptor apagado que lleva un disfraz.

records.context: Rays rise from an irregular folded lower edge, fan gently toward the sky, and breathe at different rates. A diffuse sheet joins the rays without a flat rectangular top or repeated texture tiles. The frame raster is native at ordinary Detail, within the physical screen-pixel budget, and is returned with independent ownership. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` remains the legacy comparison edge; it no longer caps the active buffer.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine#1
records.source: Rays rise from an irregular folded lower edge, fan gently toward the sky, and breathe at different rates. A diffuse sheet joins the rays without a flat rectangular top or repeated texture tiles. The frame raster is native at ordinary Detail, within the physical screen-pixel budget, and is returned with independent ownership. :data:`AURORA_BUFFER_EDGE` remains the legacy comparison edge; it no longer caps the active buffer.
records.translation: Los rayos se elevan desde un borde inferior doblado irregular, ventilador suavemente hacia el cielo, y respiran a diferentes velocidades. Una hoja difusa une los rayos sin una parte superior rectangular plana o teselas de textura repetida. records.context: The panel delegates computation to :mod:`spacr.annotation_umap_qc`. It tunes the embedding on one control subset and evaluates separation on held-out controls, reports neighbour purity rather than cluster membership, and refuses circular evaluation when phenotype scores were used to select the annotated cells.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.annotation_umap_tab#1
records.source: The panel delegates computation to :mod:`spacr.annotation_umap_qc`. It tunes the embedding on one control subset and evaluates separation on held-out controls, reports neighbour purity rather than cluster membership, and refuses circular evaluation when phenotype scores were used to select the annotated cells.
records.translation: El panel delega el cálculo a :mod:`spacr.annotation_umap_qc`. Sintoniza la incrustación en un subconjunto de control y evalúa la separación en los controles retenidos, informa de la pureza del vecino en lugar de la pertenencia al cluster, y rechaza la evaluación circular cuando se utilizan las puntuaciones del fenotipo para seleccionar las células anotadas.

records.context: Embed the annotated cells with the controls and score where they sit.

records.translation: Incrustar las células anotadas con los controles y anotar donde se sientan.

records.context: Nothing is computed until :meth:`run` is called. A UMAP over a screen's cells is seconds of work, and a tab that started it on construction would pay that cost for every user who never opens it. Build the tab: the embedding beside the per-guide table.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.annotation_umap_tab.AnnotationUmapTab#2
records.source: Nothing is computed until :meth:`run` is called. A UMAP over a screen's cells is seconds of work, and a tab that started it on construction would pay that cost for every user who never opens it. Build the tab: the embedding beside the per-guide table.
records.translation: Nada se calcula hasta que se llama :meth:`run`. Un UMAP sobre las células de una cribado es segundos de trabajo, y una pestaña que lo inició en la construcción pagaría ese costo por cada usuario que nunca lo abra. Construya la pestaña: la integración junto a la tabla por guía.

records.context: The plot and the table are two views of one result and sit side by side behind a divider the user owns -- the picture says where the cells landed, the table by how much, and reading one against the other is the whole job.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.annotation_umap_tab.AnnotationUmapTab#4
records.source: The plot and the table are two views of one result and sit side by side behind a divider the user owns -- the picture says where the cells landed, the table by how much, and reading one against the other is the whole job.
records.translation: La trama y la tabla son dos vistas de un resultado y sentarse lado a lado detrás de un divisor que el usuario posee -- la imagen dice donde las células aterrizaron, la tabla por cuánto, y leer uno contra el otro es todo el trabajo.

records.context: Called on every path that does not end in a verdict. A refusal that left the last run's scatter on application view would put a picture under a message saying this one means nothing, and the picture is what gets screenshotted.

records.source: Called on every path that does not end in a verdict. A refusal that left the last run's scatter on screen would put a picture under a message saying this one means nothing, and the picture is what gets screenshotted.
records.translation: Llamado en cada ruta que no termina en un veredicto. Una negativa que dejó la dispersión de la última ejecución en la vista de aplicación pondría una imagen bajo un mensaje diciendo que éste no significa nada, y la imagen es lo que se captura de pantalla.

records.translation: La incrustación, un punto por célula, coloreada por la pureza del vecino.

records.context: Colour is the reading and position is only the layout: a UMAP's cluster sizes and the distances between clusters are artefacts, so the picture exists to show WHERE a cell sits among the controls, and the number that says how positive that neighbourhood is comes off the colour scale.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.annotation_umap_tab.PurityScatter#1
records.source: Colour is the reading and position is only the layout: a UMAP's cluster sizes and the distances between clusters are artefacts, so the picture exists to show WHERE a cell sits among the controls, and the number that says how positive that neighbourhood is comes off the colour scale.
records.translation: El color es la lectura y la posición es sólo el diseño: los tamaños de racimos de un UMAP y las distancias entre racimos son artefactos, por lo que la imagen existe para mostrar WHERE una célula se encuentra entre los controles, y el número que dice lo positivo que es ese barrio sale de la escala de colores.

records.context: one neighbour-purity value per cell, ``nan`` allowed.

records.translation: Cada fila de objetos lee la carga, no sólo los planes seleccionados. Los contrastes más amplios del panel de comparación (187 B) necesitan las células que el montaje no eligió -- "against every other well" no tiene nada en su otro lado sin ellos -- y la unión que hace que cada medición de base de datos alcanzable (187 A) está tecleada en estas filas. Una referencia, no una copia: el marco ya está en memoria.

Overlapping buttons would defeat the alignment, so the button is given its column and no more -- which is also what "lock the width

Medido en una pantalla de 1400x900 con las columnas predeterminadas de 100 px de la tabla: "Medidas (.db)" quiere 127 px, por lo que a la izquierda en su anchura natural y centrado en su columna que llegaría a 3.5 px en el botón de Contar al lado. records.context: A button's caption is set in English when the row is built and replaced by the language pass afterwards, and "Count" is 100 px where "Contagem" is 151. A column sized once, before the translation, would clip the wider caption for the life of the screen.

Una columna de tamaño una vez, antes de la traducción, recortaría el título más amplio para la vida de la pantalla.

records.context: Anywhere spaCR asks for the *name of a database column* — the annotation column, the measurement used to prefilter extracted image regions, the heatmap feature, the regression's dependent variable — a bare text box does not show what the database already contains, so ``annotate`` and ``annotaet`` are both accepted without comment. The second starts a new annotation column, and the annotations are then split across two columns.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.column_picker#1
records.source: Anywhere spaCR asks for the *name of a database column* — the annotation column, the measurement used to prefilter crops, the heatmap feature, the regression's dependent variable — a bare text box does not show what the database already contains, so ``annotate`` and ``annotaet`` are both accepted without comment. The second starts a new annotation column, and the annotations are then split across two columns.
records.translation: Anywhere spaCR pide el nombre *de una base de datos column* — la columna de anotación, la medida utilizada para prefiltrar regiones de imágenes extraídas, la característica del mapa de calor, la variable dependiente de la regresión — un cuadro de texto desnudo no muestra lo que la base de datos ya contiene, por lo que ``annotate`` y ``annotaet`` son aceptados sin comentarios. La segunda comienza una nueva columna de anotaciones, y las anotaciones se dividen en dos columnas.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.column_picker#5
records.source: ``attach_column_picker`` a one-liner that wires the two onto a ``QLineEdit``/``QComboBox`` a screen has already laid out. It re-uses the field's own slot in its parent layout, so a host adopts the picker without restructuring anything.
records.translation: ``attach_column_picker`` un uniliner que conecta los dos en un ``QLineEdit``/``QComboBox`` una pantalla ya se ha establecido. Reutiliza la ranura propia del campo en su diseño padre, por lo que un anfitrión adopta el selector sin reestructurar nada.

records.context: Topic bars separate workflow stages and AI conversations in a shared scrolling view. The input area and transcript form a vertical ``QSplitter``; when a ``persist_key`` is supplied, its state is stored under ``console/split/<key>`` and restored per screen.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.console_panel#1
records.source: Topic bars separate pipeline stages and AI conversations in a shared scrolling view. The input area and transcript form a vertical ``QSplitter``; when a ``persist_key`` is supplied, its state is stored under ``console/split/<key>`` and restored per screen.
records.translation: Barras de temas separan etapas de flujo de trabajo y conversaciones de IA en una vista de desplazamiento compartida. El área de entrada y la transcripción forman una vertical ``QSplitter``; cuando se suministra un ``persist_key``, su estado se almacena bajo ``console/split/<key>`` y se restaura por pantalla.

records.context: Which points a rule flags is a convention, and an unstated one makes two implementations disagree about the same chart, so it is stated: **every point that is part of the evidence is flagged.** For rule 1 that is the point itself. For the run rules (2, 3, 4, 7, 8) it is every point of the run, reported as one maximal span rather than as a sliding window's worth of overlapping alarms — which is what lets :meth:`ControlChartResult.report` say "laboratory microplates P22–P30 are nine in a row above the centre line" instead of listing three violations. For the "k of m" rules (5, 6) it is the qualifying points only: a window can trigger on two points beyond 2 sigma with a third sitting on the centre line, and that third point is not flagged because it is not part of the evidence.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart#22
records.source: Which points a rule flags is a convention, and an unstated one makes two implementations disagree about the same chart, so it is stated: **every point that is part of the evidence is flagged.** For rule 1 that is the point itself. For the run rules (2, 3, 4, 7, 8) it is every point of the run, reported as one maximal span rather than as a sliding window's worth of overlapping alarms — which is what lets :meth:`ControlChartResult.report` say "plates P22–P30 are nine in a row above the centre line" instead of listing three violations. For the "k of m" rules (5, 6) it is the qualifying points only: a window can trigger on two points beyond 2 sigma with a third sitting on the centre line, and that third point is not flagged because it is not part of the evidence.
records.translation: Lo que señala una regla banderas es una convención, y una no declarada hace dos implementaciones en desacuerdo sobre el mismo gráfico, por lo que se dice: **cada punto que es parte de la evidencia está marcado.** Para la regla 1 que es el punto en sí. Para las reglas de ejecución (2, 3, 4, 7, 8) es cada punto de la ejecución, reportado como un lapso máximo en lugar de como un valor de ventana corredera de alarmas superpuestas — que es lo que permite a :meth:`ControlChartResult.report` decir "microplacas de laboratorio P22–P30 son nueve en una fila por encima de la línea central" en vez de enumerar tres violaciones. Para las reglas "k of m" (5, 6) son los puntos clasificatorios solamente: una ventana puede desencadenar en dos puntos más allá de 2 sigma con un tercero sentado en la línea central, y ese tercer punto no está marcado porque no es parte de la evidencia.

records.context: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on application view* — hidden, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. 2. *Each string is pre-rendered once into an opaque pixmap* with the background already composited in, and blitted at its current offset every frame. Drawing 5400 glyphs with ``drawText`` costs 35 ms a frame; the same glyphs as 120 opaque strips cost 0.46 ms — and an opaque strip is 25x cheaper to blit than a translucent one, which is why the alpha is baked in rather than applied by the painter. A strip is re-rendered only when its column respawns or the styling changes; the cache is ~7 MB at 1920x1080. :meth:`DnaRainWidget.set_backdrop` gives that up deliberately — a picture under the rain is not a constant to bake against — so the translucent path is taken only by the themes that have a wallpaper to show, and dark and light keep the numbers above. 3. *Only the columns that moved are repainted.* Positions are quantised to whole cells, so a column is dirty only when its integer row changes — slow columns cost nothing on most ticks. See :data:`MAX_DIRTY_RECTS` for where partial repaints stop paying.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dna_rain#19
records.source: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on screen* — hidden, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. 2. *Each string is pre-rendered once into an opaque pixmap* with the background already composited in, and blitted at its current offset every frame. Drawing 5400 glyphs with ``drawText`` costs 35 ms a frame; the same glyphs as 120 opaque strips cost 0.46 ms — and an opaque strip is 25x cheaper to blit than a translucent one, which is why the alpha is baked in rather than applied by the painter. A strip is re-rendered only when its column respawns or the styling changes; the cache is ~7 MB at 1920x1080. :meth:`DnaRainWidget.set_backdrop` gives that up deliberately — a picture under the rain is not a constant to bake against — so the translucent path is taken only by the themes that have a wallpaper to show, and dark and light keep the numbers above. 3. *Only the columns that moved are repainted.* Positions are quantised to whole cells, so a column is dirty only when its integer row changes — slow columns cost nothing on most ticks. See :data:`MAX_DIRTY_RECTS` for where partial repaints stop paying.
records.translation: 1. *El temporizador se detiene cuando el widget no está en la vista de la aplicación* — oculto, o en una ventana minimizada. Marcos cero, cero CPU. 2. *Cada cadena es pre-renderizada una vez en un pixmap* opaco con el fondo ya compuesto, y blit en su actual compensación de cada cuadro. Dibujo 5400 glifos con ``drawText`` cuesta 35 ms por marco; los mismos glificos como 120 tiras opacas cuestan 0.46 ms — y una tira opaca es 25x más barata de brillar que una translúcida, por lo que el alfa se hornea en lugar de ser aplicado por el pintor. Una tira se vuelve a renderizar sólo cuando su columna reaparece o el estilo cambia; la caché es ~7 MB en 1920x1080. :meth:`DnaRainWidget.set_backdrop` lo deja deliberadamente — una imagen bajo la lluvia no es una constante a cocinar contra — por lo que el camino translúcido es tomado sólo por los temas que tienen un papel pintado para mostrar, y oscuro y la luz mantener los números por encima. 3. *Sólo las columnas que se mueven son repintadas.* Las posiciones se cuantifican en celdas enteras, por lo tanto una columna es sucia sólo cuando su fila entera cambia — columnas lentas no cuestan nada en la mayoría de los ciclos. Ver :data:`MAX_DIRTY_RECTS` para donde las repinturas parciales dejan de pagar.

Random colour does not move that number — the hues are baked into the same cached strips, and a pen set is built once per whole degree of hue (:func:`_hue_bucket`) rather than per column, per frame.

records.source: Together: 0.53 ms a frame, 3.2 % of one core at 1920x1080 and 60 fps, and 0.00 % while off screen. records.translation: Juntos: 0,53 ms por marco, 3,2 % de un núcleo a 1920x1080 y 60 fps, y 0,00 % mientras no está en pantalla. El color aleatorio no mueve ese número: los tonos se hornean en las mismas tiras en caché, y se construye un juego de plumas una vez por cada grado de tono (:func:`_hue_bucket`) en lugar de por columna, por marco.

records.context: Why this is not ``grab()``. A live plot on a stacked page the user has never reported as an error has never been through a layout pass, so its size is whatever its parent last guessed. Measured on the real regression screen, the volcano inside the collapsed gene splitter of an unshown page: ``volcano.size()`` is 100x9 and ``grab()`` returns a 100x9 pixmap of ONE colour. That is the "blank box with a caption under it" that got the live tile deleted from the figure grid instead of fixed.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.FastPlot.snapshot#3
records.source: WHY THIS IS NOT ``grab()``. A live plot on a stacked page the user has never raised has never been through a layout pass, so its size is whatever its parent last guessed. Measured on the real regression screen, the volcano inside the collapsed gene splitter of an unshown page: ``volcano.size()`` is 100x9 and ``grab()`` returns a 100x9 pixmap of ONE colour. That is the "blank box with a caption under it" that got the live tile deleted from the figure grid instead of fixed.
records.translation: Por qué esto no es ``grab()``. Un gráfico en vivo en una página apilada que el usuario nunca ha reportado como un error nunca ha sido a través de un pase de diseño, por lo que su tamaño es lo que sea que su padre haya adivinado por última vez. Medido en la pantalla de regresión real, el volcán dentro del divisor de genes colapsado de una página no mostrada: ``volcano.size()`` es 100x9 y ``grab()`` devuelve un pixmap de 100x 9 de color ONE. Es la "caja en blanco con un título debajo de él" que tiene la tesela viva eliminada de la cuadrícula de figuras en lugar de fijo.

records.source: ``None`` for an empty plot is the other half. A tile showing an empty plot invites a click that opens an empty plot, and a run that has fitted nothing yet should have no tile at all rather than a misleading one.
records.translation: ``None`` para un gráfico vacío es la otra mitad. Una tesela que muestra un diagrama vacío invita a un clic que abre un gráfico vacía, y una ejecución que no ha encajado nada todavía no debe tener tesela en absoluto en lugar de una engañosa.

records.context: A split that would hide points is refused; this is the one place that rule is applied. A broken axis is a piecewise-linear ruler whose tick labels still read the data's own values, so every mark stays at its own number -- but a mark inside the hidden band has no number left on the ruler to sit at, and drawing it in the break would put a point somewhere its value is not. That is the same thing y-axis jitter does, and the design forbids it for the same reason.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.FastPlot.y_split_reason#1
records.source: A split that would hide points is refused; this is the one place that rule is applied. A broken axis is a piecewise-linear ruler whose tick labels still read the data's own values, so every mark stays at its own number -- but a mark inside the hidden band has no number left on the ruler to sit at, and drawing it in the break would put a point somewhere its value is not. That is the same thing y-axis jitter does, and the design forbids it for the same reason.
records.translation: Se rechaza una división que ocultaría puntos; este es el único lugar en el que se aplica la regla. Un eje roto es una regla lineal a trozos cuyas etiquetas de las marcas todavía leen los propios valores de los datos, así que cada marca permanece en su propio número -- pero una marca dentro de la banda oculta no tiene ningún número en la regla a la que sentarse, y dibujarla en la ruptura pondría un punto en algún lugar donde su valor no lo es. Eso es lo mismo que hace el jitter del eje y, y el diseño lo prohíbe por la misma razón.

records.context: Benjamini-Hochberg's adjusted P is a cumulative minimum taken from the largest P downwards -- ``q_(i) = min over j >= i of (n * p_(j) / j)`` -- and the ``min`` is both what enforces monotonicity and what creates ties: the moment a later rank produces a smaller value, every earlier rank is pulled down onto it. Measured on reference runs: 823 q values with 31 distinct, 19 tied levels covering 811 coefficients, GRA14 and 225160 both at 4.1150e-03. A volcano drawn against that has a staircase for a y-axis, and no transform can separate two tests that hold the same number.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.VolcanoPlot#2
records.source: Benjamini-Hochberg's adjusted P is a cumulative minimum taken from the largest P downwards -- ``q_(i) = min over j >= i of (n * p_(j) / j)`` -- and the ``min`` is both what enforces monotonicity and what creates ties: the moment a later rank produces a smaller value, every earlier rank is pulled down onto it. Measured on reference runs: 823 q values with 31 distinct, 19 tied levels covering 811 coefficients, GRA14 and 225160 both at 4.1150e-03. A volcano drawn against that has a staircase for a y-axis, and no transform can separate two tests that hold the same number.
records.translation: La P ajustada de Benjamini-Hochberg es un mínimo acumulativo tomado de la P más grande hacia abajo -- ``q_(i) = min over j >= i of (n * p_(j) / j)`` -- y la ``min`` es tanto lo que impone la monotonicidad como lo que crea lazos: el momento en que un rango posterior produce un valor menor, cada rango anterior se tira hacia abajo sobre él. Medido en ejecuciones de referencia: 823 valores q con 31 distintos, 19 niveles vinculados que cubren 811 coeficientes, GRA14 y 225160 ambos en 4.1150e-03. Un volcán dibujado contra el que tiene una escalera para un eje y, y ninguna transformación puede separar dos pruebas que tienen el mismo número.

records.source: That distinction is not cosmetic. ``grna_csv``, ``row_csv`` and ``column_csv`` are declared ``str`` and go straight to ``pd.read_csv``, so rendering them as a list turned a working default into ``['/path/to/barcodes_row.csv']`` the moment the screen was opened and saved. The panel emits :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` and the host re-hands the computed frame to whatever it is driving — the trellis, the gate editor, the feature explorer, the Local Data Filter. No other integration is needed: a computed column is an ordinary column from the moment it exists, classified by the same :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` rule as a measured one, so it appears in the column well, in the filter picker and in the export without any of them being told about formulas.

records.context: The first implementation chose the two axes that happened to face the camera.  That made the X/Y/Z plane buttons cosmetic: turning the view could make a data-selection boundary land on a different plane from the blue aura.  The selected plane is now the source of truth.  A genuinely edge-on plane is refused because its two data dimensions collapse to one screen line and no inverse exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_editor.GateCanvas.volume_axis_map#3
records.source: The first implementation chose the two axes that happened to face the camera.  That made the X/Y/Z plane buttons cosmetic: turning the view could make a gate land on a different plane from the blue aura.  The selected plane is now the source of truth.  A genuinely edge-on plane is refused because its two data dimensions collapse to one screen line and no inverse exists.
records.translation: La primera implementación eligió los dos ejes que pasaron a la cara de la cámara. Eso hizo que los botones del plano X/Y/Z cosmético: girar la vista podría hacer un límite de selección de datos tierra en un plano diferente del aura azul. El plano seleccionado es ahora la fuente de la verdad. Un plano realmente borde-en se niega porque sus dos dimensiones de datos colapsan a una línea de pantalla y no existe inversamente.

records.context: Frozen: settings are replaced wholesale rather than mutated, so a screen can compare what it has against what it is given and re-read the table only when something that actually costs a read has changed.

records.context: Emits :attr:`settings_changed` as the user edits, so the settings that CAN be applied live are, without waiting for OK. The ones that cannot -- sampling, which means re-reading the table -- are applied by the screen when it sees them change, which is why the signal carries the whole settings object rather than one microscope field of view.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_settings.GateSettingsDialog#1
records.source: Emits :attr:`settings_changed` as the user edits, so the settings that CAN be applied live are, without waiting for OK. records.translation: Emite :attr:`settings_changed` como el usuario edita, por lo que los ajustes que se pueden aplicar en vivo son, sin esperar a OK. Los que no pueden -- muestreo, lo que significa releer la tabla -- son aplicados por la pantalla cuando los ve cambiar, razón por la cual la señal lleva todo el objeto de configuración en lugar de un campo de visión del microscopio.

records.context: the dialog and its layout CONTAINERS are made transparent. records.context: A dialog that brought its own card is left alone. records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.glass.wants_glass#1
records.source: A DIALOG THAT BROUGHT ITS OWN CARD IS LEFT ALONE. The setup screen builds one and lays its slides out inside it; glassing it added a SECOND card, and the second one covered the first one's contents -- `childAt` over the GitHub button returned the card, so the click never reached it.
records.translation: Un diálogo que trajo su propia carta se deja solo. records.context: One class for every tab including Home. There used to be two — a dense icon-beside-name row for Home and a tall card carrying the app's one-line description everywhere else — and the difference made the first tab read as a list and the rest as a launcher. The description is gone with them: it was a third copy of a sentence already on the tooltip and in the hint bar at the foot of the page, and three lines of 11 px grey under every tile is what made the tiles small enough to need two sizes in the first place.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.AppTile#1
records.source: One class for every tab including Home. There used to be two — a dense icon-beside-name row for Home and a tall card carrying the app's one-line description everywhere else — and the difference made the first tab read as a list and the rest as a launcher. The description is gone with them: it was a third copy of a sentence already on the tooltip and in the hint bar at the foot of the page, and three lines of 11 px grey under every tile is what made the tiles small enough to need two sizes in the first place.
records.translation: Una clase para cada pestaña, incluyendo Home. Solía haber dos —una densa fila de iconos al lado de un nombre para Home y una carta alta que llevaba la descripción de una línea de la aplicación en todas partes— y la diferencia hizo que la primera pestaña se leyera como una lista y el resto como un lanzador. La descripción se ha ido con ellos: era una tercera copia de una oración ya en la punta de la herramienta y en la barra de sugerencias al pie de la página, y tres líneas de 11 px gris debajo de cada mosaico es lo que hizo que los mosaicos fueran lo suficientemente pequeños como para necesitar dos tamaños en primer lugar.

records.context: Deliberately **not** an :class:`HTile` subclass. ``HTile`` is a horizontal row whose name and description live in a ``QLabel`` stack beside the button's own icon; this is a vertical stack with the icon drawn as a child label. It has its own object name, ``AppTile``, so the stylesheet can give it a height floor without giving one to every horizontal tile in the app.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.AppTile#2
records.source: Deliberately **not** an :class:`HTile` subclass. ``HTile`` is a horizontal row whose name and description live in a ``QLabel`` stack beside the button's own icon; this is a vertical stack with the icon drawn as a child label. records.translation: Deliberadamente **no** an :class:`HTile` subclase. ``HTile`` es una fila horizontal cuyo nombre y descripción viven en una pila ``QLabel`` junto al icono del botón; esta es una pila vertical con el icono dibujado como etiqueta infantil. Tiene su propio nombre de objeto, ``AppTile``, por lo que la hoja de estilos puede darle un piso de altura sin dar uno a cada mosaico horizontal en la aplicación.

records.context: The notes are bundled, and the bundle is what is drawn. They come from ``spacr/resources/release_notes.json``, which ``tools/build_release_notes.py`` writes from the GitHub releases and which ``.github/workflows/release.yml`` refreshes on every release. This panel is on the first screen the application shows; content read from api.github.com would be empty offline, rate-limited behind a shared NAT, and slower to draw than the window. The bundled file therefore remains the offline source and the panel is complete before any network access.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.home.NewsPanel#1
records.source: The notes are bundled, and the bundle is what is drawn. They come from ``spacr/resources/release_notes.json``, which ``tools/build_release_notes.py`` writes from the GitHub releases and which ``.github/workflows/release.yml`` refreshes on every release. This panel is on the first screen the application shows; content read from api.github.com would be empty offline, rate-limited behind a shared NAT, and slower to draw than the window. The bundled file therefore remains the offline source and the panel is complete before any network access.
records.translation: Las notas están empaquetadas, y el paquete es lo que se dibuja. Vienen de ``spacr/resources/release_notes.json``, que ``tools/build_release_notes.py`` escribe de las versiones GitHub y que ``.github/workflows/release.yml`` actualiza en cada versión. Este panel está en la primera pantalla que muestra la aplicación; el contenido leído de api.github.com estaría vacío sin conexión, la tasa limitada detrás de un NAT compartido, y más lento de dibujar que la ventana. Por lo tanto, el archivo incluido sigue siendo la fuente offline y el panel está completo antes de cualquier acceso a la red.

records.source: Rendered through a QPushButton rather than a QLabel because the word is a control: a button is what Tab reaches, what Space activates, what a screen reader announces as pressable, and what already has a `:pressed` state to hang the click colour on. A clickable QLabel has none of that.
records.translation: Se muestra a través de un QPushButton en lugar de una QLabel porque la palabra es un control: un botón es lo que Tab alcanza, qué Espacio activa, qué anuncia un lector de pantalla como pulsable, y qué ya tiene un estado `:pressed` para colgar el color del clic en. Un QLavel pulsable no tiene nada de eso.

The cached-or-download decision, the button's busy state and the failure message are the same for Plate Viewer, Tabulate, Graph Builder and the rest; what differs is only which field is filled and which method opens it. records.translation: Un ayudante sirve a cada pantalla. La decisión de caché o descarga, el estado ocupado del botón y el mensaje de fallo son los mismos para Plate Viewer, Tabulate, Graph Builder y el resto; lo que difiere es sólo qué campo se llena y qué método se abre. Así que una pantalla pasa esa diferencia como una devolución de llamada y nada más.

records.source: The strip holds its text, for the same reason as the per-setting strip: a link that appears only while the pointer is on the tile is a link that cannot be clicked, because moving toward it removes it. So the strip keeps the last module hovered for thirty seconds -- long enough to notice it, cross the window and press a word.
records.translation: La tira sostiene su texto, por la misma razón que la tira de ajuste: un enlace que aparece sólo mientras el puntero está en el mosaico es un vínculo que no se puede hacer clic, porque moverse hacia él lo elimina. Así que la banda mantiene el último módulo suspendido durante treinta segundos -- el tiempo suficiente para notarlo, cruzar la ventana y pulsar una palabra.

records.context: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#4
records.source: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.translation: **Pistas cortas.** La longitud media del paso y la rectitud son inestables en una pista de tres puntos: la recta es exactamente 1.0 para cualquier pista de dos puntos, cualquiera que sea la célula. Así que la distribución de la longitud de la pista se dibuja junto a la parcela de velocidad con el corte marcado, y la longitud mínima es un ajuste en vivo que decide qué pistas entran en los números de velocidad y rectitud.

records.context: The panel is duck-typed: the binding asks for two methods -- ``collect`` and ``set_value_for_key`` -- and not for a class. That keeps the binding testable against a key-value mapping rather than against a built screen.

records.source: The panel is duck-typed: the binding asks for two methods -- ``collect`` and ``set_value_for_key`` -- and not for a class. That keeps the binding testable against a dictionary rather than against a built screen.
records.translation: El panel es de tipo pato: la unión pide dos métodos -- ``collect`` y ``set_value_for_key`` -- y no para una clase. Esto mantiene la unión probable contra una asignación de valor clave en lugar de contra una pantalla construida.

records.context: **MCD is deterministic given a seed.** The subset search is randomised, so ``random_state`` is set from :attr:`OutlierSpec.seed` and the same table gives the same flags every time — a figure in a report matches the screen it came from. An isolation forest is a randomised ensemble whose per-object score wobbles between fits.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#23
records.source: **MCD is deterministic given a seed.** The subset search is randomised, so ``random_state`` is set from :attr:`OutlierSpec.seed` and the same table gives the same flags every time — a figure in a report matches the screen it came from. An isolation forest is a randomised ensemble whose per-object score wobbles between fits.
records.translation: **MCD es determinista dada una semilla.** La búsqueda de subconjuntos es aleatoria, por lo que ``random_state`` se establece a partir de :attr:`OutlierSpec.seed` y la misma tabla da las mismas banderas cada vez — una figura en un informe coincide con la pantalla de la que vino. Un bosque de aislamiento es un conjunto aleatorizado cuya puntuación por objeto oscila entre los ajustes.

records.context: **A well is not scored on three objects.** Below :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` objects the median is too noisy for a comparison across microplate sample positions to mean anything, so the well appears in the well frame with ``well_scored = False`` and a reason saying how many objects it had. It is **never silently dropped and never quietly scored** — a low-n well excluded without a word is how an empty well becomes an unremarkable row.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#31
records.source: **A well is not scored on three objects.** Below :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` objects the median is too noisy for a comparison across wells to mean anything, so the well appears in the well frame with ``well_scored = False`` and a reason saying how many objects it had. It is **never silently dropped and never quietly scored** — a low-n well excluded without a word is how an empty well becomes an unremarkable row.
records.translation: **Un pozo no se puntúa con tres objetos.** Por debajo de los objetos :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` la mediana es demasiado ruidosa para una comparación a través de posiciones de muestra microplaca para significar cualquier cosa, por lo que el pozo aparece en el marco del pozo con ``well_scored = False`` y una razón diciendo cuántos objetos tenía. Es **nunca cayó silenciosamente y nunca anotó en silencio** — un pozo de baja n excluido sin una palabra es cómo un pozo vacío se convierte en una fila no notable.

records.context: ``(centre, scale, note)``. ``note`` is ``""`` when the MAD did the work, ``"mad-zero"`` when the fallback fired, ``"constant"`` when the feature has no variation at all (scale 0, nothing can be an outlier), and ``"empty"`` when there is nothing finite to measure.
